data: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2023, Microsoft reported revenue of $211.9 billion ($211,915 million) and net income of $72.4 billion ($72,361 million), or $9.68 per diluted share. Revenue rose about 7% from $198.3 billion in fiscal year 2022, the year ended June 30, 2022. Net income, by contrast, fell about 1% from $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022. Operating income grew about 6% to $88.5 billion over the same period.
